design.ordered_prompt_template: Select one candidate using the following priority order. 1. Referent identity: determine which entity the query refers to, rather than choosing the most active participant. 2. Relation and role: keep candidates for that entity only when its observable actor, affected-object or recipient role and relations agree with the query. Do not interchange participants. 3. Visible extent: among candidates compatible with that identity and role, prefer the region covering the complete visible target entity rather than a part or a region mixing other entities and background. Greater area alone is not evidence of completeness. 4. Abstention: if no candidate reliably satisfies identity, role and visible target extent, return 0. Apply these checks internally; do not output explanations.
design.original_criteria: Select the ID whose outlined region best corresponds to the complete referent in the query, including its action/role. Do not select a body part or a nearby different object. If none is reliable, return 0.

clock_proof.scope: single uniform-grid seconds dtype coercion; no other AST changes
